verdict.rationale: Column's docs describe support for FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types and state accounts are FDIC insured (column-docs-2, column-docs-17), and Custom Roles allow granular access control over specific bank accounts (column-docs-19), giving some transparency into structure and access. However, there is no explicit documentation of how/where FDIC pass-through insurance attaches for FBO vs individual accounts, nor a clear statement of who can see the ledger beyond role permissions. Missing for 10: dedicated pass-through FDIC insurance disclosure, explicit ledger-visibility/audit documentation, and independent confirmation of these compliance details.
